chapter.title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY

heading: Attempt to commit suicide.
text: Whoever attempts to commit suicide and does any act towards the commission of such offence, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year [4][or with fine, or with both.]
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by Act 8 of 1882, s. 7, for “and shall also be liable to fine”.
